rules: Use Cabinet Grotesk for all headings, ensuring tight tracking (tracking-tight) for an authoritative feel.
Never use Inter or default generic fonts for headings.
Use IBM Plex Sans for body text to ensure maximum readability for dense financial data.
Use JetBrains Mono or IBM Plex Mono for all numeric values in tables, balances, and charts to ensure tabular alignment.
Keep text sizes moderate: H1 max text-4xl sm:text-5xl. Use text-sm for overlines/labels with uppercase and tracking-widest.
Color is function only. The UI should be primarily monochrome (white, zinc-100, zinc-950).
Use Personal Blue and Business Amber exclusively to differentiate the two transaction types. Do not use these colors for unrelated UI decorations.
Ensure all text against colored backgrounds meets at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio.
Always set text color on hover explicitly.
Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-4 or gap-6.
Widget scaling: Single metrics span 1 col, main charts span 2 or 3 cols.
Use generous internal padding for containers (p-6 or p-8) and flat solid surfaces.
Never center by default; prefer left-alignment for all dense data, inputs, and paragraphs.
F-Pattern Information Architecture: Sticky top bar with Month/Year selector, and clean tabs for main sections.

components_strategy.surfaces: Flat Solid (Max 8px border-radius, crisp 1px borders, no soft shadows. Only use subtle ambient shadow for hover states.)
components_strategy.cards: Cardless or strictly rectangular flat cards with border-zinc-200. No heavy dropshadows.
components_strategy.buttons: Square or subtle-rounded buttons. Primary actions use solid monochrome (zinc-900), toggle buttons for Personal/Business use their respective brand colors.
components_strategy.tables: Shadcn Table with clear border-b separation, mono-font numbers, right-aligned amounts.
components_strategy.inputs: Shadcn Select, Input, and Form with sharp 1px borders.
components_strategy.modals: Shadcn Dialog for the 'Add Entry' form with backdrop-blur overlay.
components_strategy.charts: Recharts with simple, classic visualizations (Bar for income vs expense, Line for yearly trend, Pie/Donut for categories). Use the Personal Blue and Business Amber in charts.
components_strategy.pin_screen: Minimalist centered layout, monochrome, relying purely on typography and input feedback.

rules: Micro-interactions only. Hover states must subtly darken background or border.
Tabs and Modals should have a very quick (150ms) fade-in entrance.
No bounce or spring animations; keep it professional and precise.

media_and_icons.icon_usage: Use icons sparingly. Prefer text labels. Use icons mainly for directional cues (arrows), actions (edit, delete), and category markers.
rules: No decorative images. It's a pure dashboard.
All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, row actions) MUST include data-testid attributes in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts (Cabinet Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, JetBrains Mono) via Google Fonts or custom font faces in index.css.
Override Tailwind config colors to match the specific palette (zinc variations, custom blue/amber).
Implement a F-pattern dashboard with a sticky top header containing the Month, Year, and primary 'Add Entry' CTA.
Ensure amounts use the Indian numbering system format (lakhs/crores) with the ₹ symbol.
Use Recharts for all data visualization, styling them with minimal grids and mono-spaced tooltips.
The PIN lock screen should be the root route '/' or a full-screen overlay if unauthenticated, using a simple Shadcn OTP input or standard password input.
Ensure 'Personal' and 'Business' toggle in the Add Entry modal heavily highlights the chosen context (Blue for Personal, Amber for Business) to avoid mistaken entries.
Use Shadcn UI primitives for Tabs, Table, Dialog, Select, Input, Button, Card.
